consent.title: Consent
points: LifeGrid stores your blood group, approximate area, birth year, and donation and deferral dates.
Hospitals see only your group and area until you accept an invitation.
Your phone number is shared only if you and the requester both choose to share it.
Donations happen only at licensed facilities. No payment is involved.
You can download or delete your data at any time.

donorHome.eligibleBody: You may be invited when someone nearby needs your group.
donorHome.availabilityBody: Set to unavailable or travelling to pause invitations.
donorHome.override: Still contact me during quiet hours for emergencies
